name: itinerary_agent
description: Composes day-by-day itineraries, queries LocalInfoAgent for local tips and BookingAgent for accommodation after choosing hotels.

name: booking_agent
description: Handles simulated hotel and flight reservations, returning booking references for the itinerary.

name: local_info_agent
description: Provides local tips, safety information, opening hours, events, and currency conversion for the destination.
